assertions: real CLI and Web requests were both captured
every actual HTTP request carries the exact selected compiled primary policy
selected policy fits fallback system reserve without raising the budget
documented native capabilities exist in the actual request schemas
new requests carry the versioned challenger rather than legacy prompt
readonly policy does not advertise mutating/exec/plan capabilities
cli rejects invalid policy before provider or listener startup
web rejects invalid policy before provider or listener startup
limitation: A scripted local HTTP provider chooses the actions. Passing proves policy installation and runtime/tool invariants; it cannot prove policy obedience or a real-model quality gain.
